ntu.tuitionNote: AY2026-27, international students with MOE Tuition Grant (non-ASEAN 'Other International Students', incl. 9% GST): S$21,400 standard programmes, S$21,800 Business/Accountancy, S$91,250 Medicine. ASEAN internationals pay S$18,050. Non-subsidised (no TG): S$36,350-40,600 (Business S$45,600).
ntu.patchNote: Indians fall under 'Other International Students' (non-ASEAN) TG rate; TG carries a 3-year Singapore work bond. IELTS: min Overall 6, Writing 6 (only if English not medium of study/2nd language). Minimum to apply with India Std 12: at least 90% in all subjects incl. English (excl. other languages/technical subjects); NTU publishes no grade profile for Indian applicants, so indiaReq typical/high not set (indiaReqMin = official eligibility floor).

mcgill.tuitionNote: 2026-27 new international undergrads, tuition only (30 credits, guaranteed/locked for program): Arts C$54,000; Science C$64,785.90; Engineering C$65,167.50; Management (BCom) C$71,687.40; Arts & Science C$56,000.10. Total with ancillary fees + health insurance ~C$57.6k-75.3k. Typical value = approx midpoint of Arts-BCom range.
mcgill.patchNote: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, each component 6.0+. McGill India page publishes no percentage/competitive range for CBSE/ISC, so indiaReq not set.

nus.patchNote: IELTS Academic 6.5 in Overall, Reading and Writing (NUS English Language Test Scores doc, updated Sept 2026). No official Indian-qualification grade profile found; indiaReq not set.

unsw.tuitionNote: 2026 international UG fees charged per UOC (48 UOC = 1 year): Arts A$985/UOC (A$47,280/yr); Business/Commerce A$1,180 (A$56,640); Engineering & Computer Science A$1,270 (A$60,960); Science A$1,305 (A$62,640); max non-medicine A$1,350 (A$64,800); Medicine A$2,075 (A$99,600). Typical = approx midpoint of A$47k-65k.
unsw.livingNote: UNSW published Sydney estimates (annual totals incl. rent, food, utilities, phone, transport, lifestyle): on-campus apartment A$28,860-49,920 (52 wks); on-campus college A$22,220-34,440 (44 wks); share house A$30,680-40,560; 1-bed unit A$40,820-69,420. Value = share-house midpoint. Visa financial capacity A$29,710/yr.
unsw.patchNote: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, min 6.0 each subtest (some programs e.g. Education/Social Work/some Business higher).

anu.patchNote: IELTS Academic (incl. UKVI, One Skill Retake) overall 6.5 with 6.0 in each of Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking (official domain search snippet). ANU uses its own 20-point conversion for AISSC, not percentages.

macquarie.patchNote: Most UG courses require 'Competent English' = Academic IELTS 6.5 overall (official domain snippet); Law/Medicine/Education higher. CBSE = avg of best 4 externally examined subjects, but % cut-offs sit in a 403-blocked PDF; indiaReq/tuition not confirmed.

sydney.livingNote: USyd living-costs page states 'at least A$24,505 per year' (~A$2,042/month), citing the Home Affairs visa financial-capacity figure. That figure appears stale: the current Home Affairs requirement is A$29,710/yr (as cited on UNSW's page). Consider using 29,710 or flagging.
sydney.patchNote: Living = minimum visa-based figure published by USyd, not a lifestyle estimate.
